name: asyncapi-mqtt-proto-gen
description: AsyncAPI Generator template that turns an inline-proto MQTT AsyncAPI spec into a typed client project (messageBus.<channel>.publish/subscribe/address). Run with: asyncapi generate fromTemplate <spec> https://github.com/melalex/asyncapi-mqtt-proto-gen -p lang=cpp -p projectName=<name>

lang.description: Target language for the generated client. Supported values: cpp.

projectName.description: Name used for the generated project (CMake project name, include directory, C++ namespace). Defaults to a slug of info.title.

scripts.generate:example: asyncapi generate fromTemplate test/fixtures/fleet-sample.yaml . -p lang=cpp -p projectName=demo_bus -o /tmp/asyncapi-mqtt-proto-gen-example --force-write
